info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Disbursement Details API
info.description: The Disbursement Details API provides a comprehensive view of disbursement transactions identified by a unique `disbursementId`. This endpoint allows users, such as financial institutions and accounting software, to retrieve detailed information regarding specific disbursement operations. Typical consumers include account managers and financial analysts who require visibility into financial disbursements for reconciliation and reporting purposes. With this API, organizations can ensure accurate tracking and management of disbursement activities.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific disbursement by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details of a disbursement using its unique ID. It provides essential information related to the disbursement, making it useful for tracking and management purposes.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested disbursement details.
